original.target_description: Study 1: planned within-participant contrast of one item type versus multiple item types on percentage-filled quantity estimates, averaging colored dots and geometric shapes.

n.quote:
Eighty participants estimated the quantity of items in 50
random patterns of colored dots or common shapes
n.sample_role: Participants contributing repeated quantity estimates across 50 within-participant stimulus conditions; target ANOVA uses these 80 participants.
n.exclusions: No participant exclusions reported for Study 1; target test degrees of freedom are consistent with all 80 participants.

es.location: p. 409 (PDF p. 4), Study 1 Results, planned contrast

p.location: p. 409 (PDF p. 4), Study 1 Results, planned contrast

replication.target_description: Study 4: aggregated homogeneous versus heterogeneous matrix quantity estimates, paired t test. 82 complete cases; programming error caused missing estimates and prevented planned factorial ANOVA.

n.exclusions: 98 people clicked; 82 complete cases. Approximately 18 missing stimulus estimates per participant due to drawing stimuli with replacement; only last estimate retained. Printed t df=80 conflicts with nominal paired sample 82.

reported_success.quote: we failed to replicate the effect of variety on perceived quantity.

notes:
Final publication results p. 7, not supplied p. 20. Author-derived d taken from Table 3; body gives dz = -0.039. Printed sample/df inconsistency retained; n=82 is explicitly attached to both conditions in Results.
Source follow-up: Published article; supplied title and DOI match. Source text encodes equals as p and less-than as ! in statistical expressions. Requested printed F test retained without effect-size conversion. The description of presence of variety is matched to the explicitly planned one-versus-multiple-types contrast, rather than the omnibus number-of-types test. Replication and reported_success are unassigned.
